decisions.reason: Because it extends the firm’s established automation offer in a growing, R&D-intensive business with investment slack and no sign of underperformance, management would likely retain it.

As another close-to-core loading solution that fits the firm’s strategy of smarter automation and broad product support, it is likely to stay unless early market feedback proves clearly disappointing.

Although it is more distant from the core offer and therefore faces a higher risk of falling below aspirations, the firm’s expansionary posture, innovation capabilities, and visible external recognition make continued support more likely than withdrawal.
